events.evidence: The Obama administration through the United States Department of Justice lowers the fine against Germany's Deutsche Bank to a settlement of US$5.4 billion
Ten thousand pro-government troops, mostly Iranian-led Shiite militants, amass near Aleppo in preparation of a final assault on rebel-held parts of the city
Hurricane Matthew becomes a category-5 hurricane with maximum sustained winds up to 160 mph

label.note: Deutsche Bank settlement eases credit risk; war and hurricane offset.
